## ANEM16 Processor Architecture

**ANEM16** is a custom 16-bit RISC processor. anem16sim is its cycle-accurate C++11 simulator.

### Core specs
- 16 general-purpose registers (R0 hardwired to zero)
- 16-bit data width, 32-bit addresses
- Special registers: HI and LO (multiply results, extended ops)
- Harvard architecture: separate instruction memory (128K) and data memory (64K)

### 5-Stage Pipeline
Fetch → Decode → Execute → Memory → Writeback
- Data forwarding (configurable) from EX and MEM stages
- Stall logic for load-use hazards
- Branch resolution in decode stage

### Pipeline register structs: f2d, d2e, e2m, m2w

### Instruction Set (16-bit word)
Encoding: [opcode:4][regA:4][regB/shamt:4][func/off4:4]
Jump encoding: [opcode:4][address:12]
Immediate encoding: [opcode:4][regA:4][byte:8]

| Opcode | Name | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| 0x0 | R | ALU reg-reg (ADD, SUB, OR, AND, XOR, NOR, SLT, SGT, MUL) |
| 0x1 | S | Shift (SHL, SHR, SAR, ROL, ROR) |
| 0x2 | SW | Store word |
| 0x3 | LW | Load word |
| 0x4 | LIU | Load immediate upper byte |
| 0x5 | LIL | Load immediate lower byte |
| 0x6 | BHLEQ | Branch HL equal |
| 0x8 | BZ | Branch if zero |
| 0xC | JR | Jump register |
| 0xD | JAL | Jump and link |
| 0xE | M1 | Special HI/LO ops (MFHI, MFLO, MTHI, MTLO, load/add imm) |
| 0xF | J | Jump (PC-relative) |
